10.heading: This is:
refs: etc. Or, as Dr. Waterland renders, "This my affliction is a change of the right hand of the Most High," i.e., it proceeds from a change of God's conduct towards me. De Dieu renders, Precari, hoc meum est
mutare dextram Altissimi "To pray, this is my business: to change the right hand of the Most High." I can do nothing else than pray: God is the Ruler of events.
Mr. N. M. Berlin translates, Dolere meum hoc est: mutare est dextre Altissimi. "To grieve is my portion: to change (my condition) belongs to the right hand of the Most High." Psa 31:22
10.body:
etc. Or, as Dr. Waterland renders, "This my affliction is a change of the right hand of the Most High," i.e., it proceeds from a change of God's conduct towards me. I can do nothing else than pray: God is the Ruler of events.
